title: MZ Looking for Battle GUI/HUD plugins

posts.author: Analogi
posts.body: To keep it short, I started a project and I'm somewhat new to RPG maker and I really want to change how the GUI for battles look. I'm currently using HUD maker ultra and I realize it helps me make custom HUDS but not GUI (stuff I can click like: attack/special/defend). So I'm wondering if there's a plugin to help me make custom GUI buttons to change how it looks.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MZ Support to JS Plugin Requests.
